items.claim: Borislav Nikolic has never been knocked out across his 18 professional fights.
items.quote: He has what 18 fights, never been knocked out.

items.claim: Borislav Nikolic has an opportunistic submission game and has finished many of his wins by submission.
items.quote: he's one of those guys that has a very opportunistic submission game... and he's finished a lot of his wins by submission.

items.claim: Marko Vlogdan has taken a massive amount of cumulative damage in his recent fights, including absorbing 165 significant strikes in his Contender Series fight.
items.quote: he went out there and absorbed 165 significant strikes, took a ton of damage, and then he took a ton of damage in his debut

items.claim: Marko Vlogdan has a 40% striking defense.
